title_on_detail: IKEA Voluntarily Issues Expanded Recall and Allergy Alert on undeclared Hazelnut in the...
description: IKEA Voluntarily Issues Expanded Recall and Allergy Alert on undeclared Hazelnut in the CHOKLADKROKANT BREDBAR. CHOKLADKROKANT BREDBAR Chocolate flavor spread with caramel pieces Size: 14.1OZ (400G) UPC: 1602501330007 Undeclared Allergens: Hazelnut 07/29/2016 9:00 AM CHOKLADKROKANT BREDBAR 14.1 oz. (400g) are being recalled due to undeclared Hazelnuts. “All Best Before Dates”, Sold from April 30, 2015 to July 25, 2016. IKEA had samples analyzed and found them to contain hazelnut. People allergic to hazelnuts may have a severe to life-threatening reaction after consuming the CHOKLADKROKANT BREDBAR products. Products have been distributed nationwide at IKEA retail stores. There has not been any complaints or reported incidents in the United States to date. The recalled CHOKLADKROKANT BREDBAR does carry an advisory statement, which identifies that the CHOKLADKROKANT BREDBAR may contain tree nuts. Consumers are encouraged to return the affected products to the nearest IKEA store for a full refund, proof of purchase is not required. If you have any questions or concerns please call Customer Service toll free 1-888-966-4532 (24/7) or IKEA.us We are sorry for any inconvenience this may cause.
remedy: IKEA Voluntarily Issues Expanded Recall and Allergy Alert on undeclared Hazelnut in the CHOKLADKROKANT BREDBAR., 07/29/2016 9:00 AM

title_on_detail: IKEA is recalling the LURVIG water dispenser due to a suffocation hazard to pets

title_on_detail: IKEA recalls FÖRSTÅ Coffee/Tea Maker
description: 02/28/2011 March 2011-October 2011 IKEA asks customers who have a FÖRSTÅ Coffee/Tea Maker to immediately stop using the product and bring it back to any IKEA store for a full refund. Pressure from the metal holder on the glass pot can cause it to break unexpectedly when the operator adds hot water or operates the press, posing a burn and laceration hazard. IKEA has received one report in the U.S. of the glass pot breaking. No injury was reported. IKEA has received nineteen additional reports outside of the U.S. of the glass pot breaking. In those instances, twelve burn injuries from spilt coffee/tea were reported and one report of laceration injury. FÖRSTÅ Coffee/Tea Maker were sold in two sizes, 0.4l and 1l, at IKEA stores worldwide between January 2010 and December 2010. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause. For more information, please contact IKEA toll-free (888) 966-4532. Retail price: $10.00

title_on_detail: IKEA recalls for repair SMILA wall mounted lamps due to strangulation hazard
description: 12/11/2013 8:00 AM End month: November 2014 IKEA urges all customers that have an IKEA SMILA wall mounted lamp to check immediately that the lamp and cord are out of reach of children and securely fastened to the wall. Loose lamp cords can present a strangulation hazard to infants and young children. IKEA has received a report of an incident where a 16 month old child in a crib died after becoming entangled in the cord of a SMILA wall lamp. At a separate occasion, a 15 month old child in a crib was involved in a near strangulation incident when it became entangled in a lamp’s cord. Both incidents happened in Europe. Customers are asked to contact customer service at (888) 966-4532 to receive a repair kit free of charge. The repair kit contains safety instructions and self-adhesive fasteners for attaching the lamp cord to the wall. IKEA reminds customers that any corded product such as a window covering or a blind can present a strangulation hazard. Accessible cords should always be kept out of reach of young children. IKEA apologizes for any inconvenience this may cause. Retail price: $ 5 - 30

title_on_detail: IKEA recalls LYDA jumbo cup due to burn hazard
description: 06/06/2013 10:00 AM Recall ended February 2014 IKEA asks customers who have a LYDA jumbo cup to stop using the cup immediately and bring it back to any IKEA store for a full refund. The cups can break when hot liquid is poured into them, creating a burn hazard. IKEA has received no reports of incidents or injuries in the US. There have been twenty worldwide of cups breaking in use, including ten reports of injury. The affected cups were sold between August 2012 and April 2013. No other IKEA cups are affected by this recall. For more information, please contact IKEA toll-free (888) 966-4532. IKEA apologizes for any inconvenience this may cause. Retail price: $5.00

title_on_detail: IKEA recalls HEROISK and TALRIKA Bowls, Plates, and Mugs.
description: In cooperation with the U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission, IKEA is announcing a voluntary recall of HEROISK and TALRIKA bowls, plates, and mugs made from PLA (polylactic acid or polylactide) material. The bowls, plates, and mugs can become brittle and break, causing hot food or liquid to leak out, posing a burn hazard. Only one incident, without injury, occurred in the United States. The article name (“HEROISK” or “TALRIKA”), supplier number “23348”, “Made in Taiwan”, and “PLA” are molded into the bottom of each item. HEROISK bowls, plates, and mugs were each sold in a pack of 2 and TALRIKA bowls, plates, and mugs were each sold in a pack of 4. These recalled bowls, plates, and mugs were sold in the US stores and online between from August 2019 to May 2021 for about $3.99-$11.99. Please return it to any IKEA store for a full refund. Proof of purchase (receipt) is not required. We apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your cooperation. For more information, please contact us at 888-966-4532.

title_on_detail: IKEA recalls children’s bed canopies due to potential strangulation hazard
description: 03/20/2014 10:00 AM End month: January 2015 IKEA asks customers who have a bed canopy from children’s IKEA intended to be draped around children’s cribs/beds to stop using it and bring the canopy back to any IKEA store for a full refund. The affected bed canopies are: LEGENDARISK, MINNEN bed Canopy set, BARNSLIG BOLL, MINNEN Brodyr, HIMMEL, FABLER, TISSLA and KLÄMMIG. IKEA has identified a potential strangulation hazard associated with these products. No injury has been reported, but IKEA has received reports of entanglement when the fabric/net is pulled into the cribs/beds and entangled around infant’s necks. LEGENDARISK has article number 600.506.81 and is a white canopy with golden crowns printed on the white fabric. MINNEN Bed Canopy Set has article number 900.877.58 and is a white canopy with golden swirl decorations printed on the edge of the fabric. BARNSLIG Boll has article number 201.078.30 and is a white canopy with a red pointed top. MINNEN Brodyr has article number 501.076.78 and is a white canopy with green leaf decorations sewn on the fabric. HIMMEL canopies come in four colors, all with pointed tops; HIMMEL Green has article number 701.376.41, HIMMEL White/Blue has article number 201.758.38, HIMMEL Blue has article number 901.376.40 and HIMMEL Pink has article number 101.376.39. FABLER has article number 201.308.78 and is a white canopy with the multicolored dots and upside-down triangles sewn on the fabric. TISSLA has article number 902.367.15 and is a light pink canopy with pink laces sewn on the fabric. KLÄMMIG has article number 928.165.95 and is a yellow canopy with the stand clamped to the frame of the crib. If you have one of the affected bed canopies, please stop using it immediately and bring the canopy back to any IKEA store for a full refund. For more information, please contact IKEA toll-free (888) 966-4532. IKEA apologizes for any inconvenience this may cause. Retail price: $ 10 - 30
remedy: 03/20/2014 10:00 AM End month: January 2015, IKEA asks customers who have a bed canopy from children’s IKEA intended to be draped around children’s cribs/beds to stop using it and bring the canopy back to any IKEA store for a full refund., The affected bed canopies are: LEGENDARISK, MINNEN bed Canopy set, BARNSLIG BOLL, MINNEN Brodyr, HIMMEL, FABLER, TISSLA and KLÄMMIG.

title_on_detail: IKEA Recalls MYSINGSÖ Beach Chair
description: 01/26/2017 9:00 AM [National] IKEA urges customers who purchased a MYSINGSÖ beach chair before February 2017 to bring it back to any IKEA store for replacement or a full refund. After removing the fabric seat it is possible to re-assemble the chair incorrectly leading to a risk of falls or fingertip amputation hazards. IKEA has received 13 reports of incidents worldwide, including 10 injuries, 6 of which resulted in fingertip amputations. Three of those incidents, with one fingertip amputation injury, were reported in the U.S. Replacement MYSINGSÖ beach chairs are planned to be available in IKEA stores by February 2017. They are labelled with article numbers 703.380.17 and 903.380.16 and have plastic stoppers that prevent incorrect re-assembly. Proof of purchase (receipt) is not required for a replacement chair or a full refund. For more information, please visit IKEA.us or contact IKEA toll-free (888) 966-4532. IKEA apologizes for any inconvenience this may cause. Retail price: $25.00

title_on_detail: IKEA recalls BUSA children’s folding tent Due to Laceration and Puncture Hazards
description: 09/30/2011 In cooperation with the U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission, IKEA is announcing a voluntary recall of the BUSA children’s folding tent. The steel wire frame of the tent can break, producing a sharp wire end that can protrude through the tent fabric, posing a laceration or puncture hazard. No incidents occurred in the United States. This recall involves a cube-shaped children's folding tent with model number 90192009. The brand name BUSA and IKEA and the model number are printed on a sewn-in label attached to an interior seam in the tent. The tent frame is made of flat steel wire and the tent material is pale green polyester fabric with turquoise, pink and white trim. The tent's dimensions are: L 28 1/4, W 28 1/4, H 28 1/4. This children’s tent was sold in the US stores and online between from August through September 2011 for about $8. Please return it to any IKEA store for a full refund. Proof of purchase (receipt) is not required. We apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your cooperation. For more information, please contact us at 888-966-4532 .

description: In 2016, we recalled 17.3 million chests and dressers due to the risk of tip-over accidents. At IKEA, your safety is our priority. That’s why we’re asking you to check your IKEA dresser. You may have bought it years ago, or you may have bought it secondhand yesterday. If you have a recalled IKEA chest or dresser, we want you to take action, today. Return it to your nearest IKEA store, and we’ll pay you for it. We’re offering you a cash refund, or a IKEA refund card of a higher amount. You can use the IKEA refund card to help buy a replacement dresser.

title_on_detail: IKEA recalls PASTAÄLGAR and PASTAÄLGAR FULLKORN, elk-shaped pasta due to non-declared soy content
description: 06/27/2016 6:00 AM End month: April 2015 IKEA wants to make customers aware that PASTAÄLGAR FULLKORN, elk-shaped wholegrain pasta and that PASTAÄLGAR, elk-shaped pasta, sold in the IKEA Swedish Food Market may contain soy which is not declared on the products. As precautionary measure, products with all date stamps are recalled. Soy is an allergen and persons allergic to soy may experience an allergic reaction if eating the product. The product is safe for anyone not allergic to soy. Customers allergic to soy or otherwise concerned are welcome to return PASTAÄLGAR FULLKORN, elk-shaped wholegrain pasta and PASTAÄLGAR, elk-shaped pasta, to the nearest IKEA store for a full refund. We are sorry for any inconvenience this may cause. For more information, please contact IKEA toll-free 1-888-966-4532.

title_on_detail: IKEA Recalls to Repair High Chair Due to Fall Hazard
description: 01/04/2012 January 2011 - June 2012 IKEA, in cooperation with the US CPSC, voluntarily recalls for repair the ANTILOP high chair. Customers who have an ANTILOP high chair from supplier #17389 and production date 0607-0911 (YYMM), are asked to immediately contact IKEA for instructions on how to receive replacement restraint, free of charge. The high chair restraint buckle can open unexpectedly, creating a fall hazard. IKEA has received eight reports worldwide of restraint buckles that opened unexpectedly, including three reports of children who received minor injuries after falling from the high chair. Customers with an ANTILOP high chair are asked to check the supplier number and production week number moulded into the underside of the seat. No other high chairs are affected. IKEA apologizes for any inconvenience this may cause. For more information, please contact IKEA toll-free (888) 966-4532. Retail price: $20.00

title_on_detail: IKEA recalls KARLSTAD sofa-bed mattresses and seat cushions
description: 07/31/2009 August 2009 – March 2010 IKEA recalls KARLSTAD sofa-bed mattresses and seat cushions used as mattresses for violation of the federal mattress flammability Standard. If you have a KARLSTAD sofa-bed purchased between November 2008 and June 2009 please contact Customer Services toll-free at (888) 966-4532 anytime or visit the Exchange and Returns Department at your local IKEA store to arrange free installation of a replacement mattress and seat cushions. Due to a production error the mattress and seat cushions intended to be used as a mattress of a small number of KARLSTAD sofa-beds do not meet the mandatory federal open flame standard for mattresses.The affected sofa-beds have date stamps 0845 through 0927 (YYWW) and were produced by IKEA supplier #20789. The date stamp and supplier number is located on a label attached to the underside of the sofa-bed frame. No other KARLSTAD products are affected. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause. Retail price: $850.00

title_on_detail: Extended recall scope for SNIGLAR junior beds
description: 01/29/2014 8:00 AM End month: January 2015 IKEA asks customers who have a SNIGLAR junior bed to immediately stop using the bed and check the product label on the headboard or on the underside of the bed to see if your unit is affected by this recall. IKEA has received one additional report from the UK of a metal rod on a SNIGLAR bed breaking. A child received a small scratch to the arm from the broken metal rod. The affected date stamps for SNIGLAR 1114 to 1318 are extended with date stamps 1049 to 1113. The date stamp appears on a label attached to either the headboard or the underside of the bed. Model number for SNIGLAR 500.871.66 and supplier numbers 19740 or 18157, are printed on the same label. If you have one of the affected junior beds please contact customer service at (888) 966-4532 to receive a repair kit free of charge. The repair kit contains a replacement metal rod, tools and instruction sheet. No other IKEA beds are affected by this recall. IKEA apologizes for any inconvenience this may cause.

title_on_detail: IKEA Recalls IKEA 365+ SÄNDA track due to risk of electric shock

title_on_detail: IKEA recalls PARODI glass vase from supplier #18347
description: 01/31/2007 11:00 PM February 2007 - October 2007 IKEA has received reports of incidents where the base of PARODI vase broke for no apparent reason while the vase was being lifted. Seven customers worldwide sustained cuts and in five cases hospital treatment was required. Following investigation a number of PARODI vases have been found to have too high internal stresses which may increase the risk of breakage, especially if the glass is damaged in some way, for example knocked or scratched. PARODI vase stand 70 cm (28 inches) high and weigh approximately 5 kg (11 lbs). Base diameter is 15 cm (6 inches); top diameter is 23 cm (9 inches). PARODI vase is produced in black (art. no. 20110234), white (art. no. 50112199) and clear glass (art. no. 00079545). IKEA logo, the article number and the supplier number are printed on a white sticker on the underside of the vase and on the store receipt. All glass is fragile and even robust, thick-walled designs should always be handled with care. When returning your vase, to avoid risk of breakage and possible injury, avoid placing your hands at or near the base and ensure that it is securely packaged. We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused. For more information, please contact your local store or call IKEA toll-free at (888) 966-4532. Retail price: $40.00

title_on_detail: SNUTTIG recall
description: 09/30/2002 October 2002 - September 2003 Small Part Ingestion Hazard - IKEA SNUTTIG toy (700-371-56). Retail $1.95. title_on_detail: IKEA recalls to repair KRITTER and SNIGLAR junior beds due to laceration hazard
description: 08/15/2013 8:00 AM End month: January 2015 IKEA asks customers who have a KRITTER or SNIGLAR junior bed to immediately stop using the bed and check the product label on the headboard or on the underside of the bed to see if your unit is affected by this recall. IKEA has received reports of the metal rod breaking at the attachment point to the bed side rail. This can result in partial detachment of the guard rail and exposed sharp metal edges that present a laceration hazard. Only KRITTER junior beds with date stamp (YYWW) from 1114 to 1322 and SNIGLAR junior beds with date stamp from 1114 to 1318 are affected. The date stamp appears on a label attached to either the headboard or the underside of the bed. Model number for KRITTER is 600.904.70 and for SNIGLAR 500.871.66, supplier number for KRITTER is 15361 and for SNIGLAR 19740 or 18157, are printed on the same label. If you have one of the affected junior beds please contact customer service at (888) 966-4532 to receive a repair kit free of charge. The repair kit contains a replacement metal rod, tools and instruction sheet. No other IKEA beds are affected by this recall. IKEA apologizes for any inconvenience this may cause. Retail price: $60- $90
remedy: 08/15/2013 8:00 AM End month: January 2015, IKEA asks customers who have a KRITTER or SNIGLAR junior bed to immediately stop using the bed and check the product label on the headboard or on the underside of the bed to see if your unit is affected by this recall.

title_on_detail: IKEA recalls certain VARMFRONT Power Banks due to fire hazard
description: IKEA is announcing a voluntary recall of certain VARMFRONT power banks. Due to a manufacturing issue the power banks can overheat, posing a fire hazard. The recall includes date stamps for both versions of the VARMFRONT power banks: 10400 mAh (model number E2038) with date stamp (YYWW) 2313, 2316, 2318 or 2319, or 5200 mAh (model number E2037) with date stamp (YYWW) 2318, 2319 or 2322. The date stamp is located on the backside of the product, in the bottom right-hand corner in YYWW format. VARMFRONT power banks with other date stamps are not affected by this recall. If you purchased one of these recalled power banks, please immediately stop use and return it to any IKEA store for a full refund or replacement power bank. If you are unable to return to a store, please contact IKEA for instructions on how to dispose of the power bank to receive a full refund. The recalled power banks were sold in US stores and online from July 2023 through March 2024 for about $16 and $30 respectively. Proof of purchase (receipt) is not required. We apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your cooperation. For more information, please contact us at 888-966-4532.

title_on_detail: IKEA Voluntarily Issues Expanded Recall and Allergy Alert on undeclared Milk, Hazelnut and/or Almond
description: 07/06/2016 9:00 AM CHOKLAD MÖRK, CHOKLAD MÖRK 70%, CHOKLAD LINGON & BLABAR 180g, CHOKLAD LJUS UTZ 100g, CHOKLAD NOT GODIS UTZ 100g, GODIS CHOKLADKROKANT 450g, GODIS CHOKLADRAN 168g are being recalled due to undeclared Milk, Hazelnuts and/or Almond. “All Best Before Dates”, Sold from April 30, 2015 to July 1, 2016. IKEA had samples analyzed and found them to contain milk, hazelnut and/or almond. Persons allergic to milk, hazelnuts and/or almonds may have a severe to life-threatening reaction after consuming the dark chocolate. Products have been distributed Nationwide at IKEA retail stores. There has not been any complaints or reported incidents in the United States to date. IKEA of Sweden has had one reported complaint in Japan. The recalled chocolate products do carry an advisory statement, which identifies that the chocolate may contain milk and tree nuts. Consumers are encouraged to return the affected products to the nearest IKEA store for a full refund, proof of purchase is not required. If you have any questions or concerns please call Customer Service toll free 1-888-966-4532 (24/7) or IKEA.us. We are sorry for any inconvenience this may cause.

title_on_detail: Important Safety Information about BERTBY glass-door wall cabinet
description: 09/30/2004 October 2004 – May 2005 IKEA wants all customers who bought BERTBY glass-door wall cabinet from 2002 until today to contact IKEA. Screws of the wrong size have been delivered with some of the BERTBY glass-door wall cabinets. The screws are used to attach the safety bracket to the top of the cabinet. The use of wrong screws may cause the safety bracket not to fulfil its purpose, which might result in that the cabinet is not properly secured to the wall. All concerned customers should contact IKEA or visit their local store to receive screws of the right size and an instruction for how to replace the screws in a safe way. Please note that many BERTBY glass-door wall cabinets have been delivered with the right type of screw. There is nothing wrong with the cabinet in itself, so there is no need to return the cabinet to IKEA. At IKEA we are doing our utmost to secure the quality and safety of our products. To avoid future incidents we are now re-evaluating our safety and quality routines. We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused. Retail price: $100.00

title_on_detail: IKEA recalls BLÅVINGAD fishing game due to choking hazard.
description: IKEA is announcing a voluntary recall of the BLÅVINGAD fishing game. A small metal rivet on the wooden play piece can come loose, posing a choking hazard. The recalled games have been sold in US stores and online between October 2022 and March 2023 for about $14.99. Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled fishing game and return to IKEA for a full refund. Proof of purchase (receipt) is not required. We apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your cooperation. For more information, please contact us at 888-966-4532.

title_on_detail: IKEA recalls SNIGLAR crib 70x132 for repair
description: 06/30/2011 February 2011 - August 2011 IKEA has decided to carry out a recall for repair of SNIGLAR crib 70x132. The four bolts provided with some SNIGLAR cribs to secure the mattress support are not long enough to extend through the lock nut and give visual confirmation of correct assembly. If incorrectly assembled, the mattress support could detach and collapse, creating a risk of entrapment and suffocation to a child in the crib. Customers should check the crib immediately. If the mattress support bolts extend through the nut, the bolts are the proper length and the crib is not included in the recall. If the bolts do not extend through the nut, please Contact IKEA Customer Services toll-free at (888) 966-4532 for a free repair kit. IKEA apologizes for any inconvenience this may cause customers.

title_on_detail: IKEA recalls ÄNGAR candles
description: 04/30/2006 May 2006 - June 2007 The affected products are no longer available on the NA market. However, if some customers still have outdoor candles left in their possession, we want them to return them to IKEA, or contact their local IKEA store for more information. ÄNGAR candle for outdoor use 6-p, article number 200-301-24. SAMLAS candle for outdoor use 6-p, article number 900-524-43 Return candles for a full refund - $3.99. Never place an outdoor candle on or close to material that can burn and never try to blow out an outdoor candle. At the end of the burning time the wax can ignite producing a higher flame. Flaring is a normal characteristic of outdoor candles and does not pose a risk if safety instructions are followed. We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused. For additional information, call IKEA toll-free at: (888) 966-4532. Retail price: $4.00

title_on_detail: IKEA recalls CALYPSO ceiling lamp due to Impact and Laceration Hazard
description: Wed Sep 26 2018 10:00 AM CALYPSO Ceiling Lamp. Article 000.324.16 The glass shade on some CALYPSO ceiling lamps can detach and fall, posing impact and laceration hazards. IKEA has identified 19 incident reports in the U.S., including 3 resulting in minor injury. IKEA apologizes for any inconvenience and wants to thank all customers for their understanding. For more information, please contact IKEA at 888-966-4532. Retail price: $29.00

title_on_detail: IKEA Reannounces and Expands Recall of Children’s Wall Mounted Lamps Due to Strangulation Hazard
description: 04/29/2014 10:00 AM End month: November 2014 IKEA urges all customers who have a wall mounted children’s lamp to check immediately that the lamp and cord are out of reach of children and securely fastened to the wall. Loose lamp cords can present a strangulation hazard to infants and young children. IKEA has received a report of an incident where a 16 month old child in a crib died after becoming entangled in the cord of a SMILA wall lamp. At a separate occasion, a 15 month old child in a crib was involved in a near strangulation incident with a TASSA Natt wall lamp when it became entangled in a lamp’s cord. In both incidents, which occurred in Europe, the lamp’s cord was pulled into the crib by the infant. Customers are asked to contact customer service at (888) 966-4532 to receive a repair kit free of charge. The repair kit contains a warning label, safety instructions and self-adhesive fasteners for attaching the lamp cord to the wall. IKEA reminds customers that any corded product such as a window covering or a blind can present a strangulation hazard. Accessible cords should always be kept out of reach of young children. IKEA apologizes for any inconvenience this may cause. Retail price: $ 5 - 30
remedy: 04/29/2014 10:00 AM End month: November 2014, IKEA urges all customers who have a wall mounted children’s lamp to check immediately that the lamp and cord are out of reach of children and securely fastened to the wall. title_on_detail: IKEA recalls ISDANS, TUPPLUR and ENJE Roller Blinds for repair
description: 09/30/2009 October 2009 – June 2010 If you have an ENJE, TUPPLUR or ISDANS Roller Blind please check that the tension device provided with the blinds is attached to the looped bead chain and installed into the wall or floor. The tension device reduces the risk of entanglement or strangulation to young children by limiting access to the bead chain. If the tension device is not attached to the wall or floor, there is a risk that young children may pull the bead chain around their necks. If the tension device is not attached, consumers should immediately stop using the blinds and visit the Returns and Exchanges Department at their local IKEA store or call toll-free (800) 434-IKEA to receive a free repair kit. Repair kits will be available from the second week of November. IKEA has not received any reports of injuries or incidents involving its roller blinds. We apologize for any inconvenience caused. For additional information, call IKEA toll-free at: (888) 966-4532. Retail price: $5 - $55

title_on_detail: IKEA recalls KVIBY chest of 4 drawers for repair
description: 8/31/2008 Sept 2008 – May 2009 All date stamps of the KVIBY chest of drawers were included in the 2016 Chest of Drawers Recall. Please click here to view the press release for this recall and click here to see the ways to participate in this recall. Glass knob replacement kit: If you have bought a KVIBY chest of 4 drawers with date stamp 0817 or earlier, we kindly ask you to contact Customer Service on a toll-free number; (888) 966-4532, to receive a replacement kit free of charge, by mail. The kit comprises six drawer knobs and fixing screws. The date stamp appears on a label attached to the underside of the chest of drawers. The glass drawer knobs may break either during assembly or in use, causing laceration injury. The breakages are due to over tightening the screw fitting used to attach the drawer knob to the drawer front. KVIBY chest of 4 drawers white, with 6 glass drawers knobs, article number: 201-080-90, Cost $299.00, with date stamp 0817 (YYWW) or earlier. All KVIBY chest of drawers produced with date stamp 0818 (YYWW) and onwards are supplied with the improved replacement fittings. We apologize for any inconvenience. For additional information, call IKEA toll-free at: (888) 966-4532. Retail price: $300

title_on_detail: IKEA Recalls LEOPARD High Chair
description: 11/30/2009 December 2009 – September 2010 IKEA asks customers who have a LEOPARD children’s high chair to stop using the high chair immediately and bring the seat and frame back to any IKEA store where they will receive a full refund. Snap locks that secure the seat to the frame can break, making it possible for the seat to drop through the frame. Children can suffer injury to the head and other parts of the body from falls. Detached snap locks pose a choking hazard to children. IKEA has received eleven reports of broken snap locks from outside of the United States, including one incident where the seat with child dropped through the frame. The child suffered bruised legs. In a second incident a detached snap lock was found in a child’s mouth but was removed before choking occurred. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause. For more information, please visit www.IKEA.com or contact IKEA toll-free at (888) 966-4532. Retail price: Frame - $40, Seat - $20

title_on_detail: IKEA recalls GUNGGUNG children’s swing due to fall hazard
description: 09/16/2014 2:00 AM End month: September 2015 IKEA urges customers who have a GUNGGUNG children’s swing to immediately remove the swing from children and bring it back to any IKEA store for a full refund. The suspension fittings can break in use. A child can fall from the swing, posing a risk of serious injury. There have been four reports worldwide (in one in Germany, two in Austria and one in Canada) of the suspension fittings breaking in use. In one incident a child fell and sustained a fractured leg. No incidents have been reported in the US The GUNGGUNG swing is intended for indoor and outdoor use by children ages 3-7. It is made of green polyester fabric and it hangs from an acetal plastic suspension fitting attached to a steel hook. The full length of the suspension strap, including the seat, is 17ft and the width of the seat is 0.8 ft. A permanent label is attached to one of the suspension straps, showing age recommendation (3-7), IKEA logo, Design and Quality IKEA of Sweden, GUNGGUNG, 8-digit article number (302.439.74), 5-digit supplier number (17915), 4-digit date stamp (YYMM) and Made in Vietnam. GUNGGUNG children’s swing has been sold in IKEA stores and online from June 2014. Proof of purchase (receipt) is not required for a full refund. For more information, please contact IKEA toll-free at (888) 966-4532. IKEA apologizes for any inconvenience this may cause. Retail price: $20.00

title_on_detail: IKEA recalls MELINA Roman blind due to strangulation hazard
description: 07/31/2009 August 2009 – June 2010 If you have a MELINA roman blind, please bring it back to your local IKEA store for a full refund. Exposed inner cords on the back of the blind can possibly present a strangulation hazard to young children. The name MELINA appears on a white label attached to the top of the blind. To reduce the risk of entanglement or strangulation always keep cords out of reach of young children, install safety devices provided that reduce the access to cords, and move cots and furniture that children could climb on away from blinds. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause. For additional information, call IKEA toll-free at: (888) 966-4532. Retail price: $5 - $55
